selection: Largest annotated target in each fixed category: fish-only, diver-only, and jointly fish+diver; chosen by label counts before codec outcomes.
codec: Existing CompressAI bmshj2018-hyperprior pretrained model; CPU entropy coding; q1/q3/q5; no training.
semantic_evaluator: Existing SUIM SegFormer-B0 at 256 input; same model before/after; label IoU calculated at original image size.
limitations: Three targeted validation images, not a dataset-level result.
Predicted class IoU is model output compared with human labels and is not an independent recognition score.
No human image or video rating.
No SUIM video is available in this experiment.
